articles.title: Jim Cramer bucks all the stock market negativity with 3 buy recommendations
articles.summary: Stocks fell Tuesday as investors digested a slew of big bank earnings, while memory stocks, including Club name Micron , were also under severe pressure. Goldman Sachs shares were modestly higher after the bank delivered a strong earnings beat. Jim said, "This has been my favorite and remains my favorite of the banking group."
